mapper.select:
SELECT r.RECRUITMENT_NO, r.MAX_PARTICIPANTS, r.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, p.P_CREATE_DATE, r.REC_END_DATE, r.REGION, r.PRODUCT_URL, q.QR_ID,
p.PRODUCT_NO, p.PRODUCT_TITLE, p.PRODUCT_CONTENT, p.PRODUCT_PRICE, p.PRODUCT_COUNT, p.READ_COUNT, p.CATEGORY_NO,
m.MEMBER_NO AS HOST_NO, m.MEMBER_NICK AS HOST_NAME, m.MEMBER_GRADE AS HOST_GRADE,
(SELECT I.IMG_PATH || I.IMG_RENAME FROM IMG I WHERE I.IMG_TYPE_NO = r.RECRUITMENT_NO AND I.IMG_LEVEL = 0 AND I.IMG_TYPE = 'RECRUITMENT' FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS THUMBNAIL
FROM RECRUITMENT_ROOM r JOIN PRODUCT p ON r.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN QR_AUTH q ON r.RECRUITMENT_NO = q.RECRUITMENT_NO
WHERE r.RECRUITMENT_STATUS IN ('진행', '마감') AND p.PRODUCT_DEL_FL = 'N'
ORDER BY p.P_CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT r.RECRUITMENT_NO, r.MAX_PARTICIPANTS, r.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, p.P_CREATE_DATE, r.REC_END_DATE, r.REGION, r.PRODUCT_URL, q.QR_ID,
p.PRODUCT_NO, p.PRODUCT_TITLE, p.PRODUCT_CONTENT, p.PRODUCT_PRICE, p.PRODUCT_COUNT, p.READ_COUNT, p.CATEGORY_NO,
m.MEMBER_NO AS HOST_NO, m.MEMBER_NICK AS HOST_NAME, m.MEMBER_GRADE AS HOST_GRADE,
(SELECT I.IMG_PATH || I.IMG_RENAME FROM IMG I WHERE I.IMG_TYPE_NO = r.RECRUITMENT_NO AND I.IMG_LEVEL = 0 AND I.IMG_TYPE = 'RECRUITMENT' FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS THUMBNAIL
FROM RECRUITMENT_ROOM r JOIN PRODUCT p ON r.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN QR_AUTH q ON r.RECRUITMENT_NO = q.RECRUITMENT_NO
WHERE r.RECRUITMENT_STATUS IN ('진행', '마감') AND p.PRODUCT_DEL_FL = 'N'
ORDER BY p.READ_COUNT DESC
SELECT I.IMG_NO, I.IMG_PATH, I.IMG_RENAME, I.IMG_ORIGINAL, I.IMG_LEVEL, I.IMG_TYPE, I.IMG_TYPE_NO FROM IMG I WHERE I.IMG_TYPE IN ('AD BANNER', 'MID AD IMG', 'MINI AD IMG') ORDER BY I.IMG_LEVEL ASC
SELECT * FROM RECRUITMENT_ROOM WHERE RECRUITMENT_NO = #{recruitmentNo}

SELECT RR.RECRUITMENT_NO, RR.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, P.P_CREATE_DATE AS P_CREATE_DATE, RR.REC_END_DATE, RP.JOIN_DATE, RP.CANCEL_DATE, RR.MAX_PARTICIPANTS, (SELECT NVL(SUM(PARTICIPATION_COUNT), 0) FROM RECRUITMENT_PARTICIPANT RP2 WHERE RP2.RECRUITMENT_NO = RR.RECRUITMENT_NO) AS CURRENT_PARTICIPANTS, P.PRODUCT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.PRODUCT_COUNT, M.MEMBER_NICK, M.MEMBER_ADDR, M.POINT, M.MEMBER_GRADE, NVL(M.PROFILE_IMG, '/resources/images/mypage/관리자 프로필.webp') AS HOST_PROFILE
FROM RECRUITMENT_ROOM RR JOIN PRODUCT P ON RR.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON RR.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT_PARTICIPANT RP ON RR.RECRUITMENT_NO = RP.RECRUITMENT_NO AND RP.MEMBER_NO = #{member_no}
WHERE (RR.MEMBER_NO = #{member_no} OR RP.MEMBER_NO IS NOT NULL)
AND RR.RECRUITMENT_STATUS = '완료'
AND RR.RECRUITMENT_STATUS IN ('진행', '마감')
ORDER BY RR.RECRUITMENT_NO DESC

SELECT R.REPLY_NO, TO_CHAR(R.REPLY_CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REPLY_CREATED_DATE, R.REPLY_DEL_FL, R.REPLY_CONTENT, R.SECRET_REPLY_STATUS, R.MEMBER_NO, R.REPLY_TYPE, R.REPLY_TYPE_NO, R.PARENT_REPLY_NO, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPLY R2 WHERE R2.PARENT_REPLY_NO = R.REPLY_NO AND R2.REPLY_DEL_FL = 'N') AS REPLY_COUNT, M.PROFILE_IMG, M.MEMBER_NICK FROM REPLY R JOIN RECRUITMENT_ROOM RR ON R.REPLY_TYPE_NO = RR.RECRUITMENT_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE R.MEMBER_NO = #{member_no} AND R.REPLY_TYPE = 'RECRUITMENT' AND R.REPLY_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY R.REPLY_CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT R.REVIEW_NO, R.REVIEW_CONTENT, R.REVIEW_STAR, TO_CHAR(R.REVIEW_CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REVIEW_CREATED_DATE, TO_CHAR(R.REVIEW_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REVIEW_UPDATE_DATE, R.REVIEW_DEL_FL, R.REVIEW_TYPE, R.REVIEW_TYPE_NO, R.MEMBER_NO, RR.RECRUITMENT_NO AS BOARD_NO, P.PRODUCT_TITLE AS BOARD_TITLE FROM REVIEW R JOIN RECRUITMENT_ROOM RR ON R.REVIEW_TYPE_NO = RR.RECRUITMENT_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON RR.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE R.MEMBER_NO = #{member_no} AND R.REVIEW_TYPE = 'RECRUITMENT' AND R.REVIEW_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY R.REVIEW_CREATED_DATE DESC

mapper.select: SELECT IMG_NO, IMG_PATH, IMG_RENAME, IMG_ORIGINAL, IMG_LEVEL, IMG_TYPE, IMG_TYPE_NO FROM IMG WHERE IMG_TYPE = 'RECRUITMENT' AND IMG_TYPE_NO = #{recruitmentNo} ORDER BY IMG_LEVEL ASC

SELECT r.REPLY_NO, r.REPLY_CREATE_DATE, r.REPLY_DEL_FL, r.REPLY_CONTENT, r.SECRET_REPLY_STATUS, r.MEMBER_NO, r.REPLY_TYPE, r.REPLY_TYPE_NO, r.PARENT_REPLY_NO, m.PROFILE_IMG, m.MEMBER_NICK FROM REPLY r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO WHERE r.REPLY_TYPE = 'RECRUITMENT' AND r.REPLY_TYPE_NO = #{recruitmentNo} AND r.REPLY_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY r.REPLY_CREATE_DATE ASC

SELECT r.RECRUITMENT_NO, r.MAX_PARTICIPANTS, r.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, p.P_CREATE_DATE AS P_CREATE_DATE, r.REC_END_DATE, r.REGION, r.PRODUCT_URL, q.QR_ID, p.PRODUCT_NO, p.PRODUCT_TITLE, p.PRODUCT_CONTENT, q.QR_TOKEN, q.QR_IMAGE_PATH, d.TRACKING_NUMBER, TO_CHAR(d.DELIVERY_EXPECTED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DELIVERY_EXPECTED, TO_CHAR(d.MEMBER_RECEIVE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS MEMBER_RECEIVE_DATE, p.PRODUCT_PRICE, p.PRODUCT_COUNT, p.READ_COUNT, p.CATEGORY_NO,
m.MEMBER_NO AS hostNo, m.MEMBER_NICK AS hostName, m.MEMBER_GRADE AS hostGrade,
rp.CERT_STATUS
FROM RECRUITMENT_ROOM r JOIN PRODUCT p ON r.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT_PARTICIPANT rp ON r.RECRUITMENT_NO = rp.RECRUITMENT_NO AND rp.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} LEFT JOIN QR_AUTH q ON r.RECRUITMENT_NO = q.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT_DELIVERY d ON r.RECRUITMENT_NO = d.RECRUITMENT_NO
WHERE r.RECRUITMENT_NO = #{recruitmentNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPLY ( REPLY_NO, REPLY_CREATE_DATE, REPLY_DEL_FL, REPLY_CONTENT, SECRET_REPLY_STATUS, MEMBER_NO, REPLY_TYPE, REPLY_TYPE_NO, PARENT_REPLY_NO ) VALUES ( SEQ_REPLY_NO.NEXTVAL, SYSDATE, 'N', #{replyContent}, 'N', #{memberNo}, 'RECRUITMENT', #{recruitmentNo}, NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE REPLY SET REPLY_DEL_FL = 'Y' WHERE REPLY_NO = #{replyNo} AND (MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} OR #{memberNo} = 1)
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_PRODUCT_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( PRODUCT_NO, PRODUCT_TITLE, PRODUCT_CONTENT, PRODUCT_PRICE, PRODUCT_COUNT, READ_COUNT, CATEGORY_NO, MEMBER_NO, P_CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{productTitle}, #{productContent}, #{productPrice}, #{productCount}, 0, #{categoryNo}, #{memberNo}, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_RECRUITMENT_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO RECRUITMENT_ROOM ( RECRUITMENT_NO, MAX_PARTICIPANTS, RECRUITMENT_STATUS, REC_END_DATE, REGION, PRODUCT_URL, MEMBER_NO, PRODUCT_NO ) VALUES ( #{recruitmentNo}, #{maxParticipants}, '진행', TO_DATE(#{recEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{region}, #{productUrl}, #{memberNo}, #{productNo} )
INSERT INTO RECRUITMENT_PARTICIPANT ( MEMBER_NO, JOIN_DATE, CANCEL_DATE, RECRUITMENT_NO, PARTICIPATION_COUNT, CERT_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{memberNo}, SYSDATE, NULL, #{recruitmentNo}, #{myQuantity}, 'Y' )
mapper.update: UPDATE RECRUITMENT_ROOM SET PRODUCT_URL = #{productUrl}, REC_END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{recEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), REGION = #{region}, MAX_PARTICIPANTS = #{maxParticipants} WHERE RECRUITMENT_NO = #{recruitmentNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO IMG ( IMG_NO, IMG_RENAME, IMG_PATH, IMG_ORIGINAL, IMG_LEVEL, IMG_TYPE, IMG_TYPE_NO ) VALUES ( SEQ_IMG_NO.NEXTVAL, #{imageReName}, #{imagePath}, #{imageOriginal}, #{imageLevel}, 'RECRUITMENT', #{imageTypeNo} )
INSERT INTO RECRUITMENT_PARTICIPANT ( MEMBER_NO, JOIN_DATE, RECRUITMENT_NO, PARTICIPATION_COUNT ) VALUES ( #{memberNo}, SYSDATE, #{recruitmentNo}, #{myQuantity} )

INSERT INTO POINT_HISTORY ( POINT_HISTORY_NO, USED_DATE, POINT_AMOUNT, USAGE_DETAIL, POINT_TYPE, POINT_TYPE_NO, MEMBER_NO ) VALUES ( SEQ_POINT_HISTORY_NO.NEXTVAL, SYSDATE, #{pointAmount}, #{usageDetail}, #{pointType}, #{pointTypeNo}, #{memberNo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE RECRUITMENT_DELIVERY SET TRACKING_NUMBER = #{trackingNumber}, DELIVERY_EXPECTED = TO_DATE(#{deliveryExpected}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), MEMBER_RECEIVE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{memberReceiveDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE RECRUITMENT_NO = #{recruitmentNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPORT ( REPORT_NO, REPORT_TITLE, REPORT_DETAIL, REPORT_DATE, REPORT_STATUS, REPORT_TYPE, REPORT_TYPE_NO, MEMBER_NO, REPORTED_USER_NO, REPORT_M_REPLY ) VALUES ( SEQ_REPORT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{reportTitle}, #{reportDetail}, SYSDATE, #{reportStatus}, #{reportType}, #{reportTypeNo}, #{memberNo}, #{reportedUserNo}, #{reply} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.MEMBER_NO, m.MEMBER_NICK, m.MEMBER_GRADE, m.MEMBER_ADDR, m.ENROLL_DATE AS enrollDate, m.PROFILE_IMG AS profileImg FROM RECRUITMENT_ROOM r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO WHERE r.RECRUITMENT_NO = #{recruitmentNo}
SELECT ROUND(AVG(REVIEW_STAR), 1) FROM REVIEW WHERE REVIEW_TYPE = 'RECRUITMENT' AND REVIEW_TYPE_NO IN ( SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO FROM RECRUITMENT_ROOM WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POINT_HISTORY WHERE POINT_TYPE = 'RECRUITMENT' AND POINT_TYPE_NO = #{recruitmentNo} AND USAGE_DETAIL != '완료'
mapper.update: MERGE INTO RECRUITMENT_DELIVERY d USING DUAL ON (d.RECRUITMENT_NO = #{recruitmentNo}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TRACKING_NUMBER = #{trackingNumber}, DELIVERY_EXPECTED = TO_DATE(#{deliveryExpected}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), MEMBER_RECEIVE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{memberReceiveDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DELIVERY_ID, RECRUITMENT_NO, TRACKING_NUMBER, DELIVERY_EXPECTED, MEMBER_RECEIVE_DATE) VALUES (SEQ_DELIVERY_ID.NEXTVAL, #{recruitmentNo}, #{trackingNumber}, TO_DATE(#{deliveryExpected}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{memberReceiveDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
